📖 Game script

Minnesota is 3–0 because of its defense: 13.7 points allowed and a 22.7% third-down rate allowed under Brian Flores. The offense gains only 4.3 yards per play, and Justin Jefferson is out. Kyler Murray is listed active on the 10/03 feed, but Bookmaker had no Minnesota passing market at its 10/03 capture (BetOnline priced him at 183+ on Oct 2), so the QB status needs a check. Aaron Jones Sr. (−200 to score at BetOnline), Jordan Addison and T.J. Hockenson carry the offense. Miami is without De'Von Achane; Malik Willis (170+ passing) throws to Malik Washington (39+) and Chris Bell (35+), with Jaylen Wright (29+) in the backfield. It's a fixed-roof stadium. Minnesota by eight, so Miami covers +10; 36 points, under 38.5.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

MIA: Action Network (+11), Sharp or Square (+11), Stuckey, and three more at +10.5: PJ Walsh's PRO projection, and Steve Makinen and Wes Reynolds of VSiN. MIN: Derrik Klassen (−10.5) and Mike Florio (Vikings 24–14); Dave Tuley passes. Under: Doug Kezirian of Action Network and SDQL GURU (38.5), Josh Shepardson of Sharp Football (39, a best bet), Andrew Erickson (39.5) and BettingPros (41.5). Evan Abrams' primer has two systems on Miami (fading no-pedigree favorites, and the winless-team system). There are two big-money flags on Miami: MIA +10 has 30% of tickets and 46% of the money, and the MIA moneyline has 4% of tickets and 26% of the money. The line went from the Action Network open of MIN −10.5 to −10, and the total from 42.5 to 38.5. The lean is MIA +10. The under is the right side but four points are already gone; Action Network's Evan likes Willis' rushing over as the prop. Card: Single MIA +10 ($15) is the biggest single, MIA +10 is also in the Slot 5 Hybrid, and MIA +10.5 is a proposed SuperContest pick (book +10 on both SuperContest tickets). The 7b Afternoon prop stack carries a Malik Willis interception, a deliberate partial hedge against the MIA spread.

⚠️ What breaks it

Minnesota's defense scores, or Willis turns it over twice under pressure from Flores, and the Vikings win by 14. If Murray doesn't start, Minnesota's offense gets even thinner, which helps the under and the Miami cover but adds noise. Recheck at the 11:35 PT inactive window.
